text: The photo shows an automation workcell viewed from above at an angle. In the centre, a white plastic tray or rack with a grid of square recessed wells (roughly four rows of three) sits tilted on a pale plastic plate mounted to a grey aluminium extrusion rail running diagonally across the frame. The wells appear empty; no liquid is visible. Beside the tray, on the same plate, is a printed fiducial marker (black-and-white square pattern) labelled "820", and a round white disc/lid lies behind it. At the right is a white robot arm base with black cabling and a black cable-carrier hose arching overhead. Background shows a grey metal panel, a white bracket, and dark cabinetry at lower right.
